justification: Adds progress print lines to the AI reader's retry loop used by the production dcp-extract job; the return value, retry decisions and exceptions are unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: Measured 2026-10-25: Railway dcp-extract run started 20:58 UTC logged '[extractor] LLM document reader (sol)' and then nothing for 50 minutes on one 28-page chapter (3 chunks of 12 pages, 900 s read timeout, 5 retries each).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The Sol path printed nothing per call or per retry, so slow, retrying and hung looked the same.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Each call now prints its duration and response size; each failure prints its exception type and whether it will retry.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A provider exception is printed and then handled exactly as before (retry or raise).
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: None for users; operators can now see where an extraction run is spending its time.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a reader call or a retried failure prints no line, or the returned text changes
falsifiable_check.observed_red: YES: with the original _call_with_retry the new test fails (1 failed).

functions.name: _call_with_retry
functions.input: the model name, the chunk PDF bytes and the reader prompt text
functions.output: the provider's raw text, unchanged; one printed line per attempt
functions.if_none: an empty response prints '0 chars back' and is returned as before

break_it.what_happens: one 'failed' line without 'retrying', then the error is raised as before
a 'failed ... retrying' line then a 'call 2' line

break_it.scenario: A provider returns None instead of text
break_it.what_happens: the line prints '0 chars back' and None is returned as before

break_it.scenario: Sol: stdout closed or BrokenPipe while printing
break_it.what_happens: the valid text is returned once; the provider is not called again
break_it.how: success line printed outside the try, all lines via _progress which swallows OSError/ValueError

post_merge.db_reset: None: no schema or data change.
post_merge.other_repo: None. Railway: dcp-extract must be redeployed from main for the lines to appear; do not deploy while an extract run is in progress (a deploy kills it).
post_merge.manual_verify: Next dcp-extract run: railway logs show a '[reader] sol call N: ...s' line per chunk.
